notes: v0.19.4: Quest Home floating-tools button now opens Quest System directly, with the Quest-native toolkit identified consistently. Quest floating overlays are completely disabled, including legacy experimental opt-in, sticky service restarts, foreground recovery, and overlay controls; old Quest overlay preferences are cleared on Companion launch. Android phone floating tools and recovery are unchanged. Redundant account-menu shortcuts to avatar favorites, extended favorites, private notes, and inbox were removed from Settings; the features remain accessible from Home/Explore. Quest player tracking defaults to Documents/Logs folder permission with Shizuku nested under Advanced as a fallback; phone player tracking still requires Shizuku. Existing staff gating, phone interface outside these duplicate links, Relay, GM4/GM1, and Quest OSC stay unchanged. No Main Launcher or Relay deployments.
